Useful report details
Help us reproduce it

Include your Fusion version, operating system, add-in version, steps to reproduce, and any relevant Fusion error message.

Frequently asked questions
What does the add-in export?

It exports the active or visible Fusion sketch as a DXF. Regular sketch entities are placed on the CUT layer and construction geometry is placed on the MARK layer.

Which details should I include in a bug report?

Include your Fusion version, operating system, add-in version, the steps you took, the expected result, and what happened instead. A screenshot of an error is helpful.

Can I send a Fusion design or DXF file?

Yes, but only if you are comfortable sharing it. Describe the issue first; we will let you know if a sample file would help investigate it.

Do you publish user questions?

Only with your explicit permission. The form includes an optional checkbox allowing us to turn the question into an edited FAQ without personal details.

Contact support

Your message is submitted through Netlify Forms. You can also email support@kenzap.com.
